changelog:
game-ui-voice-pack 0.1.1

- Initial release for generating voiceover packs from game UI lines written by the studio.
- Supports 8–20 individually labeled UI audio cues (e.g., button, win, fail) from supplied copy.
- Handles pronunciation tables, voice cloning (with explicit consent), and brand-safe outputs.
- All remote Beatra API calls routed exclusively through the bundled MCP client, not REST/OpenAPI.
- Enforces explicit workflow for billing, card confirmation, audio review, and update safety.
summary: Turn written game UI lines into one game voiceover clip per labeled cue. This game UI voice studio records each button voice clip, win voice line, and fail voice line from the copy the studio already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 game cue audio files. Use it for game UI voice packs that keep one cue on each clip.
